name: DHRP-8: Multi-Universe Portfolio Benchmark
description: An 8-asset-class portfolio evaluation benchmark spanning developed markets, emerging markets, commodities, sectors, global multi-asset, factors, crypto, and bonds. Each universe contains 10 ETFs with daily prices and volume fetched by script from public upstream sources, plus financial news headline features and Fama-French factor data where available. The release consists of code, metadata, protocols, and generated non-proprietary outputs; raw upstream archives are not redistributed.
license: MIT for DHRP-8 code and scripts; CC-BY-4.0 for this metadata file and documentation. Generated model checkpoints produced by the authors may be used under MIT unless a downstream dependency imposes stronger terms. FinBERT-derived embeddings inherit the ProsusAI/finbert CC-BY-NC-4.0 non-commercial restriction. Raw ETF prices, volumes, news, Fama-French factors, and optional AQR source files are not redistributed here and remain subject to their upstream provider terms. Users are responsible for complying with those terms when re-fetching data.
citeAs: @inproceedings{amador2027dhrp, title={DHRP: A Differentiable Hierarchical Risk Parity Architecture and Multi-Universe Portfolio Benchmark}, author={Amador Jaime, Jose Luis}, year={2027}}
rai:dataCollection: ETF prices and volumes are obtained from Yahoo Finance v8 API (public). Financial news headlines are fetched from public RSS/GDELT-style sources by script, subject to upstream terms. FinBERT embeddings (768-dim) are extracted using the ProsusAI/finbert HuggingFace model. Fama-French factors are fetched via Kenneth French's online data library. AQR commodity Value/Momentum series were considered only as optional robustness data and are omitted from the main released factor results because the available commodity window is incomplete.
rai:dataBiases: Static ETF universes do not adjust for delisting or universe changes between 2012 and 2026, introducing a small survivorship bias. CPER (commodities) and several factor ETFs have inception dates after 2012 and are filled with NaN until inception. The Crypto universe history is shorter (2020-2026 only) due to limited ETF availability before 2020.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: All headlines are tagged with their primary ticker via either explicit metadata (Reuters/Bloomberg) or fuzzy matching against the universe ticker list. Headlines without a clear single-asset attribution are tagged as 'MARKET' and used as fallback when an asset has fewer than 2 headlines in a 90-day rolling window.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains only public market data and public news headlines. No individuals, no PII.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Initial anonymous artifact release for AAAI 2027 review. Yearly updates will extend the out-of-sample window after acceptance. Versioned persistent identifiers will be added post-acceptance.
